stats.text:
Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Life Domain Spells**

| Cleric Level | Prepared Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/aid}*, *{ref:spell/bless}*, *{ref:spell/cure-wounds}*, *{ref:spell/lesser-restoration}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/mass-healing-word}*, *{ref:spell/revivify}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/aura-of-life}*, *{ref:spell/death-ward}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/greater-restoration}*, *{ref:spell/mass-cure-wounds}* |
